name: CompanyScope
description: Company intelligence aggregator — one MCP tool call returns a full company profile with founding info, tech stack, key people, financials, news, and corporate data from 7 free public data sources including Wikipedia, GitHub, SEC EDGAR, and web scraping.

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Get a comprehensive company profile from a domain or company name

tools.name: get_tech_stack
tools.description: Detect the technology stack a company uses

tools.name: get_key_people
tools.description: Find key people at a company with titles and contact info

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Get recent news articles about a company

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Get SEC EDGAR financial data — revenue, net income, assets, stock tickers, filings for US public companies
